findings.summary: the admitted reclaim case is named lead_ruled_locator, an authority attribution rather than a mechanism, and it is persisted into StandardNameChange receipts on the live graph, so the attribution is now data as well as source; a mechanism name (locator_only) says what the case decides
new.stale_source_ids is written on every rename, including an empty list when nothing is stale, so a reader cannot tell 'no stale binding recorded' from 'renamed before the field existed'

assert plan.successor == LOCATOR_TOMBSTONE and, at line 308, receipt['reason']['reclaiming_name'] == LOCATOR_TARGET compare the writer's echo of the arguments the test passed in; both hold whatever the writer does with them and guard no regression on their own

the gate log's '# command:' line is prose ('/python -m pytest with -m graph over the stale-binding and reclaim suites'), not the literal text handed to a shell, so the gate cannot be re-run from the log; gate-stale2/3/4 carry the same prose header

gate-stale4 reports 8 passed at revision 3c315a1c while gate-stale3 reports test_rename_stale_binding failing at the same revision; the header records the committed revision only, so an uncommitted tree and a committed one are indistinguishable and the base arm for the second commit is ambiguous

the lead's species-population ruling on tungsten_density_at_plasma_boundary is stored as a docs_hint only; docs-hint.json reads back docs_stage=accepted with the hint unrendered, so the live documentation does not yet state the ion-summed, neutral-excluded population the ruling requires

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_rename_stale_binding.py:133 fails at 3c315a1c (gate-stale3.log, 1 failed) and passes at 2993b6e0, and gate-negative-control.log shows the two admission tests reddening when _reclaim_locator_only_case is forced to refuse.
justifications.evidence: gate-stale5.log ends '8 passed' with EXIT=0 at 2993b6e0 and the negative control at gate-negative-control.log fails the two admission tests, but the log headers name no literal command and two arms at one stated revision disagree.
justifications.fit: the added Cypher constants and dataclass fields follow edit.py:3267's shape, but edit.py:3495 names the case after the authority that ruled it rather than the locator mechanism it decides.
justifications.goal_fidelity: edit.py:3998 routes lead_ruled_locator through the same archive-then-rename path, and scc-separatrix-reclaim.json records zero tombstones revived and the 2 remaining names as the lead's concept pair.
justifications.reuse: the added _dd_loci extends _dd_locus and _ReclaimCase.holders extends the history_apart holder; the census imports the classifier from scc-separatrix-remainder-run.py rather than forking it, and a capability search over imas_codex/standard_names found no existing owner of a boundary-locator equivalence pair (review/consolidation.py:26 lists position suffixes, a different concern).
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is in the manifest's declared list, and the graph_refinement.py change is reached only by the rename writer the reclaim uses.

verdicts.diff: read both commits against 60654017; 3c315a1c adds the locator-only admission, the multi-holder archive query and the census, 2993b6e0 excludes a stale source binding from the rename cohort and applies the fourth reclaim.
verdicts.done_when: the done_when is a live read-back of the separatrix census; scc-separatrix-reclaim.json records population 111, conforming 109, out_of_line 2 (the deuterium-tritium concept pair), using the classifier imported from scc-separatrix-remainder-run.py.
verdicts.goal: the goal is to reclaim the four ruled boundary spellings through the signed rename path without reviving a tombstone; edit.py:3998 admits the ruled shape and the fragment records all four applied with archive receipts.
verdicts.manifest: read; it reports 8 passed for the two disposable-graph suites with gate-stale5.log and gate-head3.log named, and states the census counts 3283/16/111/109/2.
verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; all seven paths in the diff lie inside them (edit.py, graph_refinement.py, the two test files, the fragment html/json/run.py).
